summary: Tessera Defense and Homeland Security filed an 8-K reporting an October 5, 2026 Line of Credit Agreement with Mandragola Ltd., an Israeli lender, adding a $5,000,000 revolving facility alongside the existing $2,000,000 line dated May 13, 2026. Advances are evidenced by convertible notes bearing 12% simple interest, maturing October 5, 2029, prepayable without penalty. Conversion is at the lower of the five-day NYSE American VWAP or $1.00, with 15% default interest. No outstanding balance exists; this is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. Watch dilution from variable-price conversion and lender overhang.
